verdict.rationale: Recurly is an API-driven billing SaaS with official client libraries in seven languages and real-time API access (e.g. entitlement checks), so it can be driven programmatically without the UI. The Compass MCP server also lets AI agents work with its tools and APIs. Nothing documents CI-specific usage, a CLI, or headless automation workflows. Missing for 10: an official CLI or documented CI/headless automation guide, test-mode/sandbox guidance for automated pipelines, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
